lines.en: label ramen15:
scene ramenfifteen1
I arrive at the ramen shop to find a rather...despondent looking Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: 我到了拉面店，看到的是一个相当……垂头丧气的 Tsuneyo。

lines.en: Or maybe she’s just tired. I don’t know.
lines.zh: 也可能她只是累了。我不知道。

lines.en: I can never really tell with her.
lines.zh: 她这个人我永远猜不透。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, how are you feeling right now?
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo，你现在感觉怎么样？

lines.en: : Like the world is crumbling down around me and I am but a lonely sheet of kombu.
lines.zh: : 感觉世界正在我身边崩塌，而我不过是一片孤独的海带。

lines.en: : Okay, so despondent it is.
lines.zh: : 好，那就是垂头丧气了。

lines.en: : I’m so tired.
lines.zh: : 我好累。

lines.en: : Or maybe not.
lines.zh: : 也许又不是。

lines.en: : You’re really not helping me out here.
lines.zh: : 你真是一点都不帮我。

lines.en: scene ramenfifteen2
: I’m sorry.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。

lines.en: : It was very busy before you showed up.
lines.zh: : 你来之前店里很忙。

lines.en: : Thank you for scaring the rest of the customers away. I needed a break.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你把剩下的客人都吓跑了。我需要休息。

lines.en: : The store was empty when I arrived, though.
lines.zh: : 可我来的时候店里是空的啊。

lines.en: : They must have sensed that you were coming.
lines.zh: : 他们一定是感应到你要来了。

lines.en: : The Emerald Guardian says you have a holy aura.
lines.zh: : 翡翠守护者说你身上有神圣的光环。

lines.en: : There are many people who can probably feel it.
lines.zh: : 大概有很多人能感觉到。

lines.en: : Especially since most people in this area are old and dying.
lines.zh: : 尤其是这一带大多又老又快死的人。

lines.en: : Why is it that people who are closer to death care more about religion than those who are young?
lines.zh: : 为什么越接近死亡的人，反而比年轻人更在意宗教？

lines.en: : Do we need to get into that right now?
lines.zh: : 我们现在非得聊这个吗？

lines.en: : I haven’t even touched my dinner yet.
lines.zh: : 我连晚饭都还没碰呢。

lines.en: : You haven’t ordered dinner yet.
lines.zh: : 你连晚饭都还没点呢。

lines.en: : Oh. I thought that bowl next to you was for me.
lines.zh: : 哦。我还以为你旁边那碗是给我的。

lines.en: : That is a strange thing to assume.
lines.zh: : 这假设真奇怪。

lines.en: : Well you kind of just placed it there as soon as I sat down, so I figured you were preemptively getting me something.
lines.zh: : 可我刚坐下你就把那碗放那儿了，所以我想你是提前给我准备的。

lines.en: : Oh. No.
lines.zh: : 哦。不是。

lines.en: : I placed it there for comfort.
lines.zh: : 我放那儿是为了安心。

lines.en: : There is something soothing about a bowl of miso ramen sitting beside you during casual conversation. Don't you agree?
lines.zh: : 闲聊时身边摆着一碗味噌拉面，有种让人平静的感觉。你不同意吗？

lines.en: : No. What? Why?
lines.zh: : 不。什么？为什么？

lines.en: scene ramenfifteen3
: Who knows? Perhaps that’s just the way things are...
lines.zh: : 谁知道呢。也许事情本来就是这样……

lines.en: : Don’t just look off into the distance like that was some sort of revelatory thing to say.
lines.zh: : 别那样望着远方，好像你刚说了什么大彻大悟的话。

lines.en: scene ramenfifteen4
: Fine. Then I will look directly at you for the rest of the night.
lines.zh: : 好。那我今晚剩下的时间就一直盯着你看。

lines.en: : Even when it starts to make me feel sick.
lines.zh: : 直到看得我自己都难受为止。

lines.en: : Are you enjoying this, you pervert?
lines.zh: : 你很享受吧，变态？

lines.en: : Yes, Tsuneyo. My biggest fetish is eye contact.
lines.zh: : 是啊，Tsuneyo。我最大的癖好就是眼神接触。

lines.en: The sounds of car horns leak under the old metal door of the ramen shop, showing that even places as devoid of life as the old district still have some sense of urgency to them.
lines.zh: 汽车喇叭的声音从拉面店那扇旧铁门底下渗进来，说明即便像旧城区这样了无生气的地方，也还是有那么一点紧迫感。

lines.en: Inside of Tojo Ramen, however, that never seems to be the case.
lines.zh: 可在 Tojo Ramen 里面，似乎从来不是这样。

lines.en: Well, at least while I’m here.
lines.zh: 好吧，至少我在的时候是这样。

lines.en: It’s definitely a little suspicious how Tsuneyo claims it was packed just moments before I showed up.
lines.zh: Tsuneyo 声称我出现前店里挤满了人，这确实有点可疑。

lines.en: : What do you think the reason you were so busy tonight is?
lines.zh: : 你觉得今晚这么忙是什么原因？

lines.en: : It seems like just another day to me.
lines.zh: : 在我看来跟平常没什么两样。

lines.en: : We always get busier in the winter.
lines.zh: : 冬天生意总是更好。

lines.en: : Can you think of anything more relaxing than a bowl of ramen on a cold night?
lines.zh: : 你能想到比在寒夜里吃一碗拉面更放松的事吗？

lines.en: : See, that makes a lot more sense than leeching comfort off of just having one next to you.
lines.zh: : 你看，这比「旁边摆一碗就安心」的说法有道理多了。

lines.en: : It’s just weird that I never see anyone here.
lines.zh: : 只是我从没在这儿见过别人，这就很怪了。

lines.en: : You’re a liar.
lines.zh: : 你在撒谎。

lines.en: : You purchased dinner for the intimidating blonde woman once.
lines.zh: : 你有一次给那个气势逼人的金发女人买过饭。

lines.en: : And then there was that horrible girl with the black and white stripes.
lines.zh: : 还有那个黑白条纹的可怕女孩。

lines.en: : How is Kaori horrible? She just wanted a job.
lines.zh: : Kaori 怎么可怕了？她只是想要份工作。

lines.en: : If anything, you’re horrible for being the only roadblock between her and her mission to work at every single restaurant in Kumon-mi.
lines.zh: : 要说可怕，你才是——你是她和「在 Kumon-mi 每一家餐馆打工」这一使命之间唯一的障碍。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo Tojo needs no assistance.
lines.zh: : Tsuneyo Tojo 不需要人帮忙。

lines.en: : My father never would have agreed to her working here anyway.
lines.zh: : 而且我父亲本来也绝不会同意她在这儿工作。

lines.en: : Why? She’s surprisingly competent in a...really weird way.
lines.zh: : 为什么？她以一种……很怪的方式意外地能干。

lines.en: : Like me?
lines.zh: : 像我？

lines.en: : Yes, but also no. I don’t think I’d call you surprisingly competent.
lines.zh: : 是，也不是。我大概不会用「意外地能干」形容你。

lines.en: : That’s fair.
lines.zh: : 这话倒也公道。

lines.en: : But the real reason is her tattoo.
lines.zh: : 但真正的原因是她的纹身。

lines.en: : Oh, yeah that makes sense.
lines.zh: : 哦，对，这说得通。

lines.en: : With all the Yakuza hanging around here someone might...look at her the wrong way and think she’s on their turf or something?
lines.zh: : 这一带全是山口组的人，说不定有人……对她看不顺眼，以为她踩了他们的地盘什么的？

lines.en: : No. My father just doesn’t like spiders.
lines.zh: : 不是。我父亲只是不喜欢蜘蛛。

lines.en: : That...makes more sense than what I said.
lines.zh: : 这……比我说的有道理。

lines.en: : I always forget that arachnophobia is an actual thing people have.
lines.zh: : 我总忘记蜘蛛恐惧症是真的有人会有的。

lines.en: scene ramenfifteen5
: Really? The research I’ve done about fear shows it as one of the most common phobias out there.
lines.zh: : 是吗？我查过的资料显示，它是最常见的恐惧症之一。

lines.en: : Yeah, but it’s just- wait, why are you researching phobias?
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过——等等，你为什么要研究恐惧症？

lines.en: : Fear plays a big role in determining a person’s actions.
lines.zh: : 恐惧在决定一个人的行动上起着很大的作用。

lines.en: : I thought that if I could understand what everyone is afraid of, I would have an easier time talking to them.
lines.zh: : 我想，如果我能明白每个人都怕什么，我就能更容易地跟他们说话。

lines.en: : What I have learned in the process is that there are fears of everything.
lines.zh: : 而在这个过程中我学到的是，什么东西都有人怕。

lines.en: : This world is so scary.
lines.zh: : 这个世界真可怕。

lines.en: : Are you afraid of spiders as well, Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : 你也怕蜘蛛吗，Tsuneyo？

lines.en: : I think so.
lines.zh: : 大概怕吧。

lines.en: : It’s not a fear that makes me want to run or scream, but an uneasy feeling that sits in the pit of my stomach like undercooked pork.
lines.zh: : 那不是一种让我想逃跑或尖叫的恐惧，而是一种像没煮熟的猪肉一样沉在胃底的不安。

lines.en: : I think that’s still technically fear, though.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这在技术上也算恐惧。

lines.en: : Probably.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。

lines.en: : Are you afraid of anything, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你有什么害怕的东西吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : Me?
: You.
: Death, I guess?
lines.zh: : 死亡吧，大概？

lines.en: : Ahh, deathophobia.
lines.zh: : 啊，死亡恐惧症。

lines.en: : I think it has a more...scientific name than that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得它有个更……科学的名称。

lines.en: : Is it the act of dying or what comes after that scares you?
lines.zh: : 你怕的是死的过程，还是死后会发生的事？

lines.en: : I guess the act of dying since reincarnation is now a confirmed thing.
lines.zh: : 大概是死的过程吧，毕竟轮回转世现在已经是确认存在的事了。

lines.en: Probably.
lines.zh: 大概吧。

lines.en: If that {i}is{/i} what actually happened to me.
lines.zh: 如果那{i}真的{/i}是发生在我身上的事。

lines.en: I don’t even know how to describe my situation at this point.
lines.zh: 我现在甚至不知道该怎么描述自己的处境。

lines.en: Who knows?
lines.zh: 谁知道呢？

lines.en: Maybe I’ll just wake up one day and this will all have been one, long dream.
lines.zh: 也许有一天我一觉醒来，发现这一切都是一场漫长的梦。

lines.en: What an ending that would be.
lines.zh: 那会是怎样一个结局啊。

lines.en: : You believe in reincarnation?
lines.zh: : 你相信轮回转世？

lines.en: : You don’t?
lines.zh: : 你不信？

lines.en: : No. My father never believed in that so neither do I.
lines.zh: : 不信。我父亲从不相信，所以我也一样。

lines.en: : You know you don't have to believe things just because your father does, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道你不必因为父亲相信什么就相信什么，对吧？

lines.en: : I want to, though. It makes everything easier.
lines.zh: : 可我愿意。那样一切都会简单些。

lines.en: : Well...what do you think happens, then?
lines.zh: : 那么……你觉得会发生什么？

lines.en: scene ramenfifteen6
: I’ve always been under the impression that we’d be buried and grow into trees.
lines.zh: : 我一直以来的印象是，我们会被埋进土里，长成树。

lines.en: : I don’t really think burying people works that way.
lines.zh: : 我觉得埋葬人不是那么运作的。

lines.en: : We’re not seeds.
lines.zh: : 我们又不是种子。

lines.en: : Not yet.
lines.zh: : 现在还不是。

lines.en: : But what if after we die, all of the unused nutrients in our body leak out in thin strips like roots.
lines.zh: : 可如果死后，我们身体里没用完的养分像根须一样渗出细条呢？

lines.en: : What if every forest we see is actually a graveyard?
lines.zh: : 如果我们看到的每一片森林其实都是墓地呢？

lines.en: : What would that make graveyards, then?
lines.zh: : 那墓园又算什么？

lines.en: scene ramenfifteen7
: Maybe that’s...where we bury trees?
lines.zh: : 也许那是……我们埋树的地方？

lines.en: : Looks like your theory fell apart, huh?
lines.zh: : 看来你的理论崩了，对吧？

lines.en: scene ramenfifteen8
: I’m just trying to repeat the things I’ve learned.
lines.zh: : 我只是想复述我学到的东西。

lines.en: : None of it really makes sense to me. But I have plenty of time to think when I’m not helping customers.
lines.zh: : 这些我其实都不太懂。不过不招呼客人的时候，我有的是时间思考。

lines.en: : You should be thanking me for always sending everyone else away, then.
lines.zh: : 那你该谢谢我总把别人赶走。

lines.en: : Me coming here is pretty good for you in that sense.
lines.zh: : 从这个意义上说，我来这儿对你挺有好处的。

lines.en: scene ramenfifteen9
: Until it drives down sales and we can’t afford electricity anymore.
lines.zh: : 直到销售额下降、我们再付不起电费为止。

lines.en: : But as long as you only come at night, we can still profit in the morning.
lines.zh: : 不过只要你只在晚上来，我们上午还能赚点钱。

lines.en: : Does your father come down and run the store in the morning still?
lines.zh: : 你父亲早上还会下来照看店里吗？

lines.en: : No, he’s unable to leave his room.
lines.zh: : 不会，他没法离开自己的房间。

lines.en: : I meant mornings on the weekend.
lines.zh: : 我指的是周末的早上。

lines.en: : We’re closed during the mornings on weekdays because I have to receive an education.
lines.zh: : 工作日的早上我们不开门，因为我得接受教育。

lines.en: : You know you could solve that problem by hiring {i}someone else{/i} to work here, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道雇{i}个人{/i}来干活就能解决这个问题，对吧？

lines.en: : But spiders.
lines.zh: : 可是蜘蛛。

lines.en: : It doesn’t {i}have{/i} to be Kaori. What about Yumi?
lines.zh: : 不{i}一定{/i}要是 Kaori。Yumi 怎么样？

lines.en: : She would be a better candidate, but I’m afraid she would call all of the customers “Mom.”
lines.zh: : 她会是更好的人选，但我怕她会把所有客人都叫「妈」。

lines.en: : She did that with one person...and that one person {i}was{/i} her mom.
lines.zh: : 她只对一个人这么叫过……而那个人{i}确实{/i}是她妈。

lines.en: : That’s just what she wants us to think.
lines.zh: : 那只是她想让我们这么以为。

lines.en: : I can see it now-
lines.zh: : 我现在就能看到——

lines.en: : {i}Mom, where do we keep the noodles?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}妈，面条放在哪儿？{/i}

lines.en: : They are in the back, my child.
lines.zh: : 在后面，我的孩子。

lines.en: : {i}Thanks, Mom! I love you.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}谢了，妈！我爱你。{/i}

lines.en: : I love you too.
lines.zh: : 我也爱你。

lines.en: : There’s a flaw in your logic. It implies Yumi has the capability to love something.
lines.zh: : 你的逻辑有个漏洞。这暗示 Yumi 有能力去爱什么。

lines.en: : If she can not love, how can I expect her to treat the food here with the respect it deserves?
lines.zh: : 如果她不会爱，我又怎么能指望她用应有的敬意对待这里的食物？

lines.en: : Can she even cook?
lines.zh: : 她连饭都不会做吧？

lines.en: : Well...no. Probably not.
lines.zh: : 嗯……不会。大概不会。

lines.en: scene ramenfifteen10
: Then there’s no point, is there?
lines.zh: : 那就没意义了，不是吗？

lines.en: : Besides, running Tojo Ramen alone helps me protect all of its secrets.
lines.zh: : 再说，独自经营 Tojo Ramen 能帮我守住它所有的秘密。

lines.en: : What would happen if a competitor discovered the special ingredient in our shio broth?
lines.zh: : 万一竞争对手发现了我们盐味汤底里的特殊配料怎么办？

lines.en: Sorry, Yumi.
lines.zh: 抱歉了，Yumi。

lines.en: Can’t say I didn’t try.
lines.zh: 不能说我没试过。

lines.en: It really would have been nice if she were able to work here.
lines.zh: 她要是能在这儿工作，那该多好。

lines.en: It’s not far from Chika’s house and it’s not like she ever comes to[school] during the day anyway.
lines.zh: 这儿离 Chika 家不远，而且她白天也从来不来[school]。

lines.en: But {s}god{/s} God forbid someone discovered Tsuneyo’s secret broth.
lines.zh: 不过上帝保佑，千万别让人发现 Tsuneyo 的秘密汤底。

lines.en: : Well, if you ever get tired and don’t want to depend on my presence for a break, it might be worth looking into getting some extra help.
lines.zh: : 嗯，如果你哪天累了、不想靠我出现才能休息，也许值得考虑找点帮手。

lines.en: scene ramenfifteen11
: The Samurai of Flavor needs no help.
lines.zh: : 风味武士不需要帮手。

lines.en: : My father was kind enough to entrust the business to me, so the least I can do is honor his wishes and not hire a spider.
lines.zh: : 我父亲好心把店交给我，我至少该尊重他的意愿，不雇一只蜘蛛。

lines.en: : I think you’re forgetting about the {i}definitely human female{/i} that spider was attached to.
lines.zh: : 我觉得你忘了那只蜘蛛依附着的那个「{i}确实是人类的女性{/i}」。

lines.en: : Spiders are just humans with more legs.
lines.zh: : 蜘蛛不过就是腿多了一点的人类。

lines.en: : No, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: : 不是的，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: scene ramenfifteen12
: Ah-
: I just don’t want you overworking yourself and then...getting buried and turning into a tree or whatever it was you assumed happened to people after death.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想你过度劳累，然后……被埋掉变成一棵树，或者随便你怎么假设人死后会变成什么。

lines.en: scene ramenfifteen13
: I can’t die yet.
lines.zh: : 我还不能死。

lines.en: : There is no one to bury me.
lines.zh: : 没人埋我。

lines.en: : Even if my father was able to regain his strength, leaving the room would prove to be very difficult for him.
lines.zh: : 就算我父亲能恢复体力，离开房间对他来说也会非常困难。

lines.en: : I’d turn into a tree wherever I died.
lines.zh: : 我会死在哪儿，就在哪儿变成一棵树。

lines.en: : And there’s nowhere I go that would be a convenient location for a tree.
lines.zh: : 而我去的地方，没有一处适合长树。

lines.en: : Imagine a situation where you came into the restaurant today and tried to have this exact conversation, but with a tree between us.
lines.zh: : 想象一下，你今天走进店里，想跟我进行一模一样的这场对话，可我们中间隔着一棵树。

lines.en: : It would be very difficult.
lines.zh: : 那会很艰难。

lines.en: : Might be good for the atmosphere, though. It’s definitely a little stuffy in here.
lines.zh: : 不过对气氛可能有好处。这儿确实有点闷。

lines.en: : Fuck you. Get out of my store.
lines.zh: : 操你的。滚出我的店。

lines.en: : Just because you found out “fuck you” isn’t an actual curse doesn’t mean it’s okay to keep using it as an insult on me.
lines.zh: : 就算你发现「操你的」不是真正的脏话，也不代表你可以一直拿它骂我。

lines.en: : But there is no one else who makes me mad and it’s a very fun thing to say.
lines.zh: : 可是没有别人能让我生气，而且这句话说着很爽。

lines.en: : You can fuck me too if you want. You’d be surprised by how fun it feels.
lines.zh: : 你想操我也行。你会惊讶于那有多爽。

lines.en: : Try it.
lines.zh: : 试试看。

lines.en: : Hurry up and fuck me, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 快点操我，Sensei。

lines.en: I pull my phone out and open up the voice recording app.
lines.zh: 我掏出手机，打开录音应用。

lines.en: I think I’m about to acquire a new ringtone.
lines.zh: 我觉得我要收获一个新铃声了。

lines.en: It will go really well with my wallpaper of Makoto stuffing a dildo in her mouth.
lines.zh: 它会跟我的壁纸——Makoto 把假阳具塞进嘴里那张——特别配。

lines.en: : Can you say that one more time, Tsuneyo?
lines.zh: : 你能再讲一遍吗，Tsuneyo？

lines.en: : Why won’t you fuck me? Is it too hard?
lines.zh: : 你为什么不肯操我？太难了吗？

lines.en: : I’ll be okay. I’m a strong woman.
lines.zh: : 我没事的。我是个强壮的女人。

lines.en: : Thanks.
lines.zh: : 谢了。

lines.en: : I have to make sure none of the other girls ever hear this.
lines.zh: : 我得确保其他女孩永远听不到这段。

lines.en: : You’re right.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。

lines.en: : It would be bad if they found out we were fucking each other this early in our relationship.
lines.zh: : 如果她们发现我们这么早就开始互相操对方，那可就糟了。

lines.en: scene ramenfifteen14
